//: ADR 0157, spec 0008 §3.4. The read set of each plugin suite: the files whose content can change its verdict. `selftest.ps1 -Changed` runs a suite when a changed file matches one of its globs. Under-declaring is the defect (a broken suite is skipped locally until CI or the next full run); over-declaring only costs time. A suite always reads itself. Globs: plugin-relative, `/`-separated, ordinal; `*` stays in one segment, `**` crosses segments; a leading `/` is repo-root-relative (checked only when the plugin is nested in its repo). The runner fails the run when a suite has no entry, a glob matches no file, or a plugin file is claimed by no suite, by no `full` glob and by no `none` glob.
//none: Read by no suite. The manifest gate and the workflow corpus gate run on the real tree ahead of the suites in every run, selected or full. CHANGELOG.md is read by manifest-gate.selftest only for the two properties the real-tree gate checks first: a top `## vX.Y.Z` entry equal to plugin.json's version, and the release-notes URL equal to the hook's.
//version_only: A changed file matched here whose diff against the ref changes only `"version": "…"` lines selects no suite: every suite that reads it reads the version value at run time. A new file or any other changed line selects as usual.
//real_tree: ADR 0157 decision 7, ADR 0159, spec 0008 §3.4. Per suite, the plugin files it reads only for a property that the real-tree gates check first in every run: the top CHANGELOG entry and its link, README.md as an append target, vendored-copy identity, dogfood-placement identity, the disabled-skills guard scope. The runner does not read this key, so these files select nothing for the suite. scripts/readset-audit.ps1 leaves them intact in that suite's broken copy and checks each entry. Measured 2026-10-18: with exactly these files restored in a broken copy, manifest-gate.selftest went green (83 of 83 cases, green control). Weak evidence: most of its cases expect a red run, which a hidden read cannot flip (ADR 0159).

suites.//manifest-gate.selftest.ps1: Its fixtures copy the whole tree, and its control cases need the unmutated copy green under manifest-gate.mjs. The runner's real-tree manifest gate run, which every run makes first, stands in for that whole-tree half: `real_tree` below names its files. The canon's docs/adr/ file names feed that half too (stubbed so the copy's citations resolve; ADRs are append-only). The globs here are the files whose literals its cases mutate or assert on.
suites.//selftest.selftest.ps1: It reads selftest.ps1 (a full input). Its F2 case asserts that no suite sits under a templates/ directory.
suites.//skills/harness-init/ci-enabled-plugins: In the canon shape it also lints every repo workflow, gated on the root .harness.json and marketplace.json existing.
